checklist.detail: Resultant injection beta angle +4.7 deg is outside the -4 to +2 deg band LOX/LH2 prefers - it wants a slightly negative beta (~0 or below). Adjust the impingement angle or element momentum ratio.

checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~2091 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.15 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: OK - primary hoop stress ~67 MPa (~8.7 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential, Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) vs a ~67 MPa allowable at the end of active cooling (area ratio ~27.5) (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5, wall ~0.67 mm). The thermal-restraint stress (~963 MPa at the throat, dT = q*t/k across the wall) is a self-limiting secondary stress, not a burst load: with the hoop load it exceeds Stainless Steel (304/316)'s ~100 MPa hot yield, so the hot face yields a little each firing - expected for a regen tube wall (the real F-1/J-2/RL10 do the same in this model). Its life limit is the 'Throat thermal-fatigue cycle life' row.
